description.value:
Trigger You gain the dying condition.

You have spent a lifetime quietly waiting underwater, barely even breathing. When most necessary, you can slow down your body's functions to give your allies time to help you before you succumb to your injuries. As you lose consciousness, you slow down your bodily functions to stave off death a little longer. Your dying condition cannot increase for any reason until after your next turn (including a failed recovery check).
